legalAndCommercialGuardrails.rule: Do not represent O'BUUMBA Ltd as registered or authorised to contract until official records and authority are verified.
legalAndCommercialGuardrails.financialAuthority: Contracts, banking, tax, payout and financial commitments require the legally eligible account holder or authorised adult representative where applicable.
legalAndCommercialGuardrails.ipOwnership: Record authorship, third-party assets, licences, tool terms, client agreements and human contributions; do not assume every AI output is exclusive company IP.
